refs.purpose: Keep source-faithful CWL facts separate from Galaxy-facing interface choices.
refs.verification: Run against the first representative CWL summaries and confirm workflow inputs/outputs map without re-parsing the original CWL.

refs.purpose: Pick among the three honest Galaxy branching translations (paired_or_unpaired input, native pick_value step, sibling workflows) before drafting the interface.
refs.trigger: When summary-cwl has any steps[].when non-null OR any workflow output uses pickValue.

refs.purpose: Choose Galaxy collection input shapes from CWL arrays, scatter inputs, records, Directory values, and secondary-file contracts.
refs.trigger: When CWL types include arrays, records, Directory, secondaryFiles, or scatter over File-like inputs.

refs.purpose: Choose Galaxy collection input shapes from CWL arrays, scatter inputs, records, Directory values, and secondary-file contracts.
refs.trigger: When CWL types include arrays, records, Directory, secondaryFiles, or scatter over File-like inputs.

refs.purpose: Choose `paired_or_unpaired` (or `list:paired_or_unpaired`) shape when the CWL discriminator is paired-vs-single reads, instead of inventing a workflow-level `reads_mode` select parameter.
refs.trigger: When summary-cwl declares 2+ optional File? read-like inputs whose step bindings are gated by complementary `when:` predicates, OR workflow outputs use pickValue over branches keyed on input presence, OR an upstream `meta.single_end`-style discriminator surfaces in the summary.

refs.purpose: Choose stable Galaxy workflow input/output labels and promoted checkpoint outputs.
refs.trigger: When deciding labels, public outputs, checkpoint outputs, or fixture-compatible collection inputs.

refs.purpose: Inherit open entries rather than re-deriving them, close the ones this brief's input, output, and label decisions settle, and append interface obligations the CWL summary leaves open — an unmapped secondaryFiles bundle, an unpinned parameter default, a collection shape the source types don't determine.
refs.verification: Promote after a worked run shows entries this Mold appends or resolves are consumed downstream without re-derivation.

refs.purpose: Read CWL workflow inputs, outputs, types, formats, secondary files, scatter, and requirement evidence before choosing the Galaxy interface.

produces.description: Reviewable Markdown brief: Galaxy workflow inputs, outputs, labels, exposed and checkpoint outputs, source provenance, confidence.
Carried obligations ledger re-emitted by this step: entries it appended or closed updated, every other entry passed through with its provenance intact.

consumes.description: Structured CWL summary emitted by [[summarize-cwl]]; the source-of-truth JSON for Galaxy interface choices.
Carried obligations ledger [[open-requirements-ledger]]: the run's open, resolved, and surrendered entries with their provenance. Absent on the first Mold of a run; start an empty one.
